metadata.title: Chiral eﬀective ﬁeld theory and nuclear forces
title_lines: Chiral effective field theory and nuclear forces
metadata.abstract: We review how nuclear forces emerge from low-energy QCD via chiral eﬀective ﬁeld theory. The presentation is accessible to the non-specialist. At the same time, we also provide considerable detailed information (mostly in appendices) for the beneﬁt of researchers who wish to start working in this ﬁeld.
